behavior_checks.behavior: relia backtest --window 180d computes confirmed and possible recurrence pairs separately.
Possible recurrences are excluded from headline ERR.
Explicit and heuristic flake discounts are reported and excluded from the ERR numerator.
Backtest writes deterministic JSON and HTML report artifact paths for repeated runs over the same shards and window.
Saved ERR baselines are compared and labeled stale when source artifact digests differ.
The recurrence gate is implemented but reports off by default under relia.yaml.
relia check flags zero-match attribution config with a concrete relia.yaml line reference.
Backtest parse and provenance failures use typed command errors with source path or line refs where possible.

redaction_posture.notes: Task-run evidence remains internal. Backtest report payloads are generated from already-redacted local experience records and mark redaction_status as customer_safe.
